strings.FPG_NEU_CONTROL: {fpg_getnamedef} is controlled by A NEUTRAL PARTY.
strings.FPG_first_and_foremost_desc: Not for nothing was the 1st Panzergrenadier Division honored with the epithet 'Berserker'. Their service record is equally glorious as the sagas of old. Every man is worth a dozen of the enemy, and has proven it beyond all doubt.
strings.FPG_backs_to_the_sea_desc: Hemmed in by the Oder and Elbe rivers, and with the Baltic at their back, PGD. 1's supplies are strained and their position tenuous. At Wegener's command, they have instituted strict rationing, and are restricted to purely defensive operations.
